responsibility: This definition module declares GNU Modula-2 bindings for getopt-style option parsing, including support for long options. It belongs to the runtime command-line parsing interface and exports the GetOpt wrapper, opaque LongOptions builder API, constants describing argument requirements, and GetOptLong/GetOptLongOnly entry points so Modula-2 code can drive libc-style short and long option parsing with DynamicStrings-based option strings.
same_name_distinction: This file is the public binding specification for getopt-style parsing, declaring the LongOptions abstraction, constants, and entry points; it does not contain the C record layout or cgetopt bridging code found in GetOpt.mod.
